label: Global Human Settlement Layer (JRC, Copernicus)
licence: European Union open data: reuse authorised with proper acknowledgment of the source
note_crs: 4326 pairs with arc-second resolutions (3ss, 30ss); 54009 (Mollweide) pairs with metres (100, 1000). WORLDPOP IS 4326, so choose 4326 if the two are to share a folder - the loader refuses a mixed-CRS folder, which is BACKLOG 239 working as designed. Whether the origins actually align has NOT been measured.
